other_verified_features.detail: The separately labelled bridge crosses the Nerang River between Macintosh Island and the beachfront park behind S07/S08; it is distinct from PB1–PB3.
S01/S02 modular rows, PIT LANE, PODIUM and the pit-entry/exit splits are shown; D001 supplies no verified heights or construction sections for the current open-pit typology.
Concrete barriers & 1.5 m debris fence; separate late-install/early-removal barriers, 1 m spectator demarcation fence, 1.8 m precinct security fence and water-filled barriers.

D001 locations differ from the current rule-spaced illustrative stands; S12 and S25 are shown. The programme-derived current list includes S22B. This is a source crosswalk question, not authority to edit operational records.

showcase_comparison.route: Current DATA.circuit is the registered K220 rev02 keyplan schematic; D001 does not establish missing lap length from its inset.
showcase_comparison.road_width: Current DATA.circuit.roadWidth explicitly measures the whole carriageway from 2022 aerial, not event barriers. D001 visibly distinguishes race surface, pit lane and unused carriageway. The v7.94 coherent corridor remains illustrative, not an extracted D001 barrier alignment.
showcase_comparison.structures: Existing source creates one rule-selected longest-straight pedestrian bridge and a nominal start gantry; it does not identify PB1–PB3 or OT1–OT5. This audit does not relocate these objects.
showcase_comparison.stands: DATA.circuit.stands says names from the fencing programme and NOMINAL placement spaced round the circuit. D001 can improve decorative siting after a source crosswalk; source schedule names and operational placements must be preserved.
showcase_comparison.pit_and_buildings: D001 validates site identity and horizontal context. It cannot substantiate exact facade appearance or structural heights; photo-informed detail inside existing nominal envelopes remains the appropriate description.

prioritised_enhancements.proposal: Introduce source-indexed PB/OT structure anchors and distinguish walking bridges from thin advertising spans
prioritised_enhancements.first_bounded_candidate: PB2 at Breaker/Pacific has an unambiguous perpendicular crossing and drawn approaches
prioritised_enhancements.required_before_rendering: Establish and independently check D001 main-sheet to existing schematic scene transform; extract actual crossing/support geometry rather than label centre; check clearances against the retained centreline/cameras and current buildings; suppress any replaced nominal object explicitly to avoid duplicates

prioritised_enhancements.proposal: Use D001 to cross-reference existing nominal stands to the correct circuit precincts
prioritised_enhancements.required_before_rendering: Reconcile D001 stand identity with programme names without changing source records; derive decorative anchors only from verified geometry

prioritised_enhancements.proposal: Model the existing river footbridge as a separate scene landmark
prioritised_enhancements.required_before_rendering: Verify source endpoints and map transform; retain water clearance and do not confuse this bridge with PB1–PB3; photos needed for verified material/height detail
